prompts.environment: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CLEAN ENVIRONMENT PLATE for Unity portrait victory screen, 1024x1824. Use supplied reference ONLY to faithfully match its painted Russian fairy-tale city architecture, landscape composition, dusk palette and floral framing. Create independent environment artwork without any UI. Dense intricate wooden Russian city with onion domes and steep carved roofs, palace in center distance, amber-lit windows, sunset warm orange near horizon at 35% of height, deep navy starry sky above. Foreground dark cobblestone path down center, tall flowers white daisies, blue and purple wildflowers growing at lower sides, birch trunks and small autumn leaves framing upper sides. Buildings fill middle third, sky open upper third. Deep warm/cool theatrical contrast, painterly finely detailed art consistent with supplied reference. Darken the sides and lower central path so gold UI can read. NO firebird, no characters, no confetti, no reward items, absolutely no text, logos, stars as badges, ribbons, borders, HUD panels or controls anywhere. Fill whole portrait with the environment, not screenshot UI removal/cropping; newly painted clean environment inspired by reference.
prompts.firebird: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one genuinely transparent isolated Firebird sprite for Unity, square canvas. Use supplied reference only for the Firebird's specific slender silhouette, open lifted wings and golden emissive style. Paint an independent complete airborne Russian fairy-tale Firebird, facing left, small elegant head with curled crest, slim curved neck and slender body, lifted wings spreading in a broad open U with separated thin feathers and AIR between feather tips. Long fine flowing tail sweeps down and to the RIGHT in thin elegant S curves; several tiny sapphire eye spots. Pose proportions: wings fill top 60% of image, slender body at center, long tail flows through lower-right 45%; completely visible with 6% transparent margin. Gold-orange layered feathers, dark copper undersides, bright golden rim-light on wing tips, fine luminous flowing tail filaments with sparse isolated sparks and SOFT transparent glow. Match airy bird in supplied reference, do not make a broad heavy solid feather shield or short bundled curled tail. Genuinely transparent alpha background including behind wings and glow; no painted checkerboard, no backdrop, no UI, no text, no ribbon, no buildings, no ground. Sprite only, full figure.
